name: TS Mahou Shoujo Nao! Bunny S!!
source:
A standalone bonus scenario after "TS Magical Girl Nao!"
No need to own the original or to have read it to understand.
There are some spoilers however.

Take a look at the slightly sexy lives of the magical girls after the battle ends.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE147788.html]DLsite English[/url]]
